_meta.role: GenAI Platform / LLM Inference Optimization Engineer (Cloud)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, focused on GPU inference optimization and performance benchmarking for deep learning workloads. Hands on with TensorRT and 8 bit quantization, delivering measurable inference speedups and memory footprint reduction on transformer and CNN models, with profiling built on pynvml and custom CUDA kernels. Background in distributed and parallel computing across MPI and SLURM managed clusters, with C/C++ and Python tooling for reproducible benchmarking pipelines.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; tuned model and decoder embedding layers for a custom document-extraction task.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through iterative preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to improve PSNR from 65 to 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing, achieving a 5.2× inference speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS) versus eager-mode PyTorch.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster.
Achieved up to 10.49× speedup with 12 slave processes; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.
